epics.sixSigmaMetric: Falsification cycle pass rate without regressions
requirements: R1: Address task plan JSON missing 'auth' or 'validation' keywords to satisfy TAG-07 refusal criteria.
R2: Fix frontend/e2e/mock-semantic-boundary.spec.mjs to stop accepting 404 for unauthorized requests.
R3: Update review verdict JSON with valid PR identifiers instead of 'PR #0'.
R4: Implement Moodle SSO integration in frontend E2E tests instead of calling local register endpoints.
R5: Implement product code changes to fix 401 errors and support Moodle SSO.
R6: Refactor tests to meet the proof obligation of showing a failing counterexample or targeted passing test that refutes incorrect claims.
R7: Ensure review verdict JSON includes minimal status fields, evidence links, and next-action fields for downstream consumption.

slices.title: Patch all self-falsification audit findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fixes for this epic, I want to patch the identified test, JSON, and code defects directly, so that the falsification cycle findings are resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the falsification audit findings, When the required JSON files, product code, and tests are updated, Then all 7 findings are completely resolved, providing both auth and validation requirements.
Given the frontend E2E tests, When evaluating unauthorized endpoints and Moodle SSO, Then the tests use actual SSO and explicitly reject 404 responses.
